Hey Oscar,

I am having no problems downloading the Session Code on my machine, so I wonder what could be going on with yours. Hope to get to the bottom of this problem.

Jamie

Hi Jamie, thanks,
I run Wallace with:
-91 points User-specified (in coordinates geographics).
-11 enviromental data (format Tif, resolution 30m and coordinates geographics).
-Process envs data, point buffer 0.005 distance and 10000 background.
-Partition Occurrence Data, Kakknife K=n
-Build and Evaluate Niche Model, Maxent, every feature classes, RM 1 and 3.
-Visualize Model Results, Map Prediction, output Cloglog, no threshold.
-Project model to area  polygon convex (around).
Up here all ok (I think), but in the module Session Code, are the problem whit the button "Download...". Installed the MiKTeX, and Run in RStudio the code Sys.getenv("PATH") y have the result of the image.

messages.body_plain:
Sorry folks -- I didn't put two and two together. It turns out there was an error in the code that did not turn on the RMD button for User Occs. I just fixed it and pushed it to the master branch on Github. Please download the Github version of v1.0.5 and let me know if it works now. Instructions for downloading the package from Github are on the repository page: https://github.com/wallaceEcoMod/wallace

Thanks so much for your patience, and for reporting this bug. I will be updating the CRAN version soon once I fix a few more other errors.

Jamie

messages.subject: Help about dowload specified csv data sheet from my computer.
messages.subject_clean: Help about dowload specified csv data sheet from my computer.
messages.body_plain:
Greeting dear all and hope this message will find you well.

My name is Guilain Tsetagho, I am a former MSc student in Applied Ecology and Wildlife Management at the University of Dschang in West, Cameroon. I am working on the  Picathartes oreas distribution in Cameroon, using Species Distribution Modelling.

Before starting, congratulations for the great job about wallace, much appreciated.

I would wish to establish the distribution map of Grey-necked Picathartes in Cameroon by using SDM. For this I am using your wallace package in R with the respect of your wallace's. But during the process, I encountered a problem during data input. In fact, in the first step, I tried to upload specified CSV occurence data sheet that I have in my computer and it upload well. But for the next step, when I clic on the button load occurence, it did not gone through and this message appear all the time that I retried:  ERROR : Please input CSV file with columns "name", "longitude", "latitude".

Now I dont know what happen. Please I sincerely need your help.

Attached is the csv data occurence that I have used.

looking forward to received a positive response from you.

Best regards,

Guilain.

Hi Guilain,

The input CSV format is very specific. The first three columns of the csv file MUST be "name", "longitude", and "latitude". And you need to use those words for the column headings. Try that and see if you can get your CSV loaded.

Matt

messages.subject: Re: Projections work
messages.body_plain:
Huy is right, you will just need to make sure that your rasters are in the same projection. And also be aware that the buffer units are in the same units as your coordinate reference system, which means that if you input UTM data you will need to enter 10000 for a 10 km buffer.

We’re working right now on better functionality for testing raster projections that are input by users, and we’ll keep you updated on any progress.

Jamie
